scripts.build: turbo run build && uv run --project apps/worker python -m compileall -q apps/worker/src
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && uv run --project apps/worker ruff check apps/worker
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && uv run --project apps/worker mypy --config-file apps/worker/pyproject.toml apps/worker/src
scripts.test: turbo run test && uv run --project apps/worker pytest -q apps/worker/tests
